time.Description: Time in relation to time zero defined by the _pet.json

plasma_radioactivity.Description: Radioactivity in plasma. Image derived input function measured from the left ventricle corrected with plasma to whole blood ratio.

whole_blood_radioactivity.Description: Radioactivity in whole blood. Image derived input function measured from the left ventricle.

metabolite_parent_fraction.Description: Parent fraction of the radiotracer. Interpolated from discrete samples
